findings.sourceReading: As the crowd around Eva parts, everyone stares at the thing Ange holds, 私のそれ: her almond. Their inspection targets the competing winning object.
findings.alternative: The preceding raised almond makes the target inferable and the following text confirms Eva’s almond too. Nevertheless at me replaces that object with Ange, while started at is also an apparent typo for stared at. The source explicitly locates the collective inspection on her object.
